up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1293286 (Polyadenylate-binding protein 1) where standard_type is 'IC50', standard_relation is '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Output columns: assay_chembl_id (from assays.chembl_id), target_type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard_type (from activities.standard_type), and pchembl_value (from activities.pchembl_value). Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id ascending. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293286' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
